resources.string: Example: 世界の歌 is written sekai no uta in Latin letters. Tap to replay the conversion.
Allow Romalala to appear over Spotify.
Overlay active · Open Spotify’s Lyrics view.

1. Allow Romalala to appear over other apps.

2. Start singing, then choose Spotify in Android’s screen-sharing dialog when available.

3. Open a Japanese song’s Lyrics view.

Romalala reads the visible words and writes their pronunciation in Latin letters. It does not translate their meaning. Line detection is approximate.

Processing happens on your phone. Captured images and lyrics are not saved. If Android shares your whole screen, stop the overlay before switching to unrelated content.

Stop here, from the notification, or with Android’s screen-sharing control.
